title: Console Judgement Request
description: Proposal (Console Service, CHARTER.md first slice): a queued request for a judgement-typed right. The request carries the question as the kernel Proposal to be ratified and the evidence a ruling needs; that Proposal must be ADMITTED before the ratify transition (SPEC.md ratify row), and whether admission occurs inside request-judgement or through a separate admit transition is open (CONS-009). The answer is a separate owned record, judgement-resolution, referenced back through resolution_id. The request never holds, infers, or delegates the right it asks for.

operation_id.description: The operation this request conditions; it receives an UNRESOLVED receipt while the request is QUEUED and unrelated operation continues.

proposal_id.description: The kernel Proposal that resolve-judgement ratifies: the request's question entered as a Proposal. It must be ADMITTED before ratify (SPEC.md ratify row); where admission occurs is open (CONS-009).

required_authority_type.description: A judgement request exists only because no live JUDGEMENT grant covered the operation; VERIFICATION authority is settled by the kernel without a request.

capability.description: Capability the resolving grant must carry, checked at the resolution transition; for resolve-judgement it is resolve-judgement (CONS-002, CONS-008).

scope.description: Scope the resolving grant must cover, checked at the resolution transition; for resolve-judgement it is this request's request_id (CONS-002, CONS-008).

loop_mode.description: IN_LOOP keeps the conditioned operation UNRESOLVED until a human right resolves it; ON_LOOP lets it proceed while a human watches and may counter through retraction.

question.description: The question put to the owner, rendered inline for the pending list; it must reproduce the bytes at question_address, which question_digest pins.

question_address.description: Address of the immutable question payload; the request is never rewritten, a changed question is a new request.

question_digest.description: Digest of the question bytes so a rendered question can be checked against the record.

decision_ref.description: Governing-document reference the question instantiates, for example STATUS.yaml#O18 or decisions/0014; null when the request is not yet an open decision.

evidence_addresses.description: Addresses of the evidence a ruling needs; a request with no evidence is refused because the owner would be asked to judge on the requester's word.

addressed_to.description: Operator (actor id) the request is addressed to, the holder of the right it asks for, and the recipient_id of the JUDGEMENT_REQUESTED notification (notification.schema.json). A request is addressed to an operator, never to a session; the request must appear on that operator's pending list, which the operator pulls from any open session.

notification_id.description: The JUDGEMENT_REQUESTED notification issued with delivery LOCAL and recipient_id equal to addressed_to; a notification is addressed to a recipient, not to a session. Null until emitted. Phase I has no push.

thread_id.description: Thread where the request surfaces for discussion and recommendation; null when raised outside any thread.

resolution_id.description: Back-reference to the judgement-resolution record that answered this request; null while QUEUED. The resolver, the grant checked, and the resolution receipt live on that record, not here.
